Ui.Script:
-- ── GlobalStrings / labels the ref reads (byte-exact 1.12 enUS, interface.MPQ) ──────────────── -- Chunk-local upvalues: the global functions below close over them; inline XML handlers (separate -- chunks) can't, so every handler routes to a function here. `_RED` variants redden only the -- number/name (met = white, unmet = red), exactly as the real requirements line reads. local PARENS_TEMPLATE = "(%s)" -- GlobalStrings.lua:2468 local REQUIRES_LABEL = "Requires:" -- REQUIRES_LABEL (2768) local COSTS_LABEL = "Cost:" -- COSTS_LABEL (667) local UNKNOWN_LABEL = "Unknown" -- UNKNOWN (3860) local FILTER_LABEL = "Filter" -- FILTER (1297) local TRAINER_REQ_LEVEL = "Level |cffffffff%d|r" -- TRAINER_REQ_LEVEL (3739) local TRAINER_REQ_LEVEL_RED = "Level |cffff2020%d|r" -- TRAINER_REQ_LEVEL_RED (3740) local TRAINER_REQ_SKILL_RANK = "%s (|cffffffff%d|r)" -- TRAINER_REQ_SKILL_RANK (3741) local TRAINER_REQ_SKILL_RANK_RED = "%s (|cffff2020%d|r)" -- TRAINER_REQ_SKILL_RANK_RED (3742) local TRAINER_REQ_ABILITY = "|cffffffff%s|r" -- TRAINER_REQ_ABILITY (3737) local TRAINER_REQ_ABILITY_RED = "|cffff2020%s|r" -- TRAINER_REQ_ABILITY_RED (3738) -- ── The state filter's three SAVED VARIABLES (decision 1128) ───────────────────────────────── -- The reference's own globals, values and mechanism: Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:6-9 assigns these -- at FILE SCOPE and its `.toc` declares them `## SavedVariables`; the client executes the -- saved file over them AFTER this file loads and BEFORE the load event, so a remembered value -- wins over the default. benilla's ported UI is one FrameXML tree rather than addons, so the -- declaration rides `RegisterForSave` (FrameXML's own API for its 38 globals) and the same -- ordering is the app's load seam. File scope is load-bearing: assign these in OnLoad and the -- default would clobber the restored value every launch. TRAINER_FILTER_AVAILABLE = 1 TRAINER_FILTER_UNAVAILABLE = 1 TRAINER_FILTER_USED = 0 RegisterForSave("TRAINER_FILTER_AVAILABLE") RegisterForSave("TRAINER_FILTER_UNAVAILABLE") RegisterForSave("TRAINER_FILTER_USED")
local LABEL_AVAILABLE = "Available" -- AVAILABLE (84) local LABEL_UNAVAILABLE = "Unavailable" -- UNAVAILABLE (3840) local LABEL_USED = "Already Known" -- USED (3868) -- The font colour codes the dropdown rows wrap their labels in (GlobalStrings.lua: the *_CODE -- family) — green/red/gray, closed with |r. local GREEN_CODE = "|cff20ff20" local RED_CODE = "|cffff2020" local GRAY_CODE = "|cff808080" local CODE_CLOSE = "|r"
-- CLASS_TRAINER_SKILLS_DISPLAYED / CLASS_TRAINER_SKILL_HEIGHT (ref Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:2-3). local BENILLA_TRAINER_ROWS = 11 local BENILLA_TRAINER_ROW_HEIGHT = 16
-- ── Detail pane ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Nothing selected → blank every detail region: a FontString "hides" via SetText(""), while the -- icon Button + coin frames Hide. Predates region Show/Hide (region.rs has the real pair now); -- equivalent either way, so the blank-text idiom stays. function BenillaTrainer_HideDetails() getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillName"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillRequirements"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillDescription"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTrainerCostLabel"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillIcon"):Hide() BenillaMoney_Clear("BenillaTrainerDetailMoney") getglobal("BenillaTrainerTrainButton"):Disable() end
-- Fill the detail pane for the selected service `id` (1-based visible index) — the transcribed -- ClassTrainer_SetSelection detail half: name/sub name, the Requires: string (built term-for-term -- as the ref does), the icon, the cost coins + label, the description, and Train's enable state. function BenillaTrainer_ShowDetails(id) local name = GetTrainerServiceInfo(id) getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillName"):SetText(name or UNKNOWN_LABEL) -- The detail header shows the spell NAME only — no "(Rank N)" beside it. A deliberate -- divergence from the ref (which sets a ClassTrainerSubSkillName subtext here): the rank is -- already on the spell's list row, so a second copy floated to the right of the name just -- read as clutter (director's call).
local icon = getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillIcon") icon:SetNormalTexture(GetTrainerServiceIcon(id) or BENILLA_FALLBACK_ICON) icon:Show()
-- Requirements string (ref term-for-term): level gate, skill gate, each prerequisite ability; -- each red when unmet (hasReq nil). Our feed has no pet-learn / step requirements. local requirements = "" local separator = "" local reqLevel = GetTrainerServiceLevelReq(id) if reqLevel and reqLevel > 1 then separator = ", " if (UnitLevel("player") or 0) >= reqLevel then requirements = requirements .. format(TRAINER_REQ_LEVEL, reqLevel) else requirements = requirements .. format(TRAINER_REQ_LEVEL_RED, reqLevel) end end local skill, rank, hasReq = GetTrainerServiceSkillReq(id) if skill then if hasReq then requirements = requirements .. separator .. format(TRAINER_REQ_SKILL_RANK, skill, rank) else requirements = requirements .. separator .. format(TRAINER_REQ_SKILL_RANK_RED, skill, rank) end separator = ", " end local numReq = GetTrainerServiceNumAbilityReq(id) for i = 1, numReq do local ability, abilityHas = GetTrainerServiceAbilityReq(id, i) if ability then if abilityHas then requirements = requirements .. separator .. format(TRAINER_REQ_ABILITY, ability) else requirements = requirements .. separator .. format(TRAINER_REQ_ABILITY_RED, ability) end separator = ", " end end if requirements ~= "" then getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillRequirements"):SetText(REQUIRES_LABEL .. " " .. requirements) else getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillRequirements"):SetText("") end
-- Cost (ref): a free service shows no coins/label; otherwise the "Cost:" label + coins, -- reddened when unaffordable (BenillaMoney_SetColor: white when GetMoney() >= cost, else red). local moneyCost = GetTrainerServiceCost(id) if moneyCost and moneyCost > 0 then getglobal("BenillaTrainerCostLabel"):SetText(COSTS_LABEL) BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaTrainerDetailMoney", moneyCost, true) if (GetMoney() or 0) >= moneyCost then BenillaMoney_SetColor("BenillaTrainerDetailMoney", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) else BenillaMoney_SetColor("BenillaTrainerDetailMoney", 1.0, 0.1, 0.1) end else getglobal("BenillaTrainerCostLabel"):SetText("") BenillaMoney_Clear("BenillaTrainerDetailMoney") end
getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillDescription"):SetText(GetTrainerServiceDescription(id))
-- Train enable (ref): only an available AND affordable service. The talent/profession-point -- gate is dropped (talentPts always 0; the profession-confirm is a later refinement). local _, _, serviceType = GetTrainerServiceInfo(id) local affordable = (GetMoney() or 0) >= (moneyCost or 0) if serviceType == "available" and affordable then getglobal("BenillaTrainerTrainButton"):Enable() else getglobal("BenillaTrainerTrainButton"):Disable() end end
-- ── The list page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Pick the first learnable (available) service, else the first non-header service (ref -- ClassTrainer_SelectFirstLearnableSkill — the backport hardcodes index 2, the first service -- under the first header; we find it, robust to which group leads / a leading collapsed group). local function selectFirstService() local n = GetNumTrainerServices() for i = 1, n do local _, _, serviceType = GetTrainerServiceInfo(i) if serviceType == "available" then SelectTrainerService(i) return end end for i = 1, n do local _, _, serviceType = GetTrainerServiceInfo(i) if serviceType ~= "header" then SelectTrainerService(i) return end end end
-- Set the collapse-all tab's +/- icon from whether every group is folded (ref -- ClassTrainerFrame_Update's numHeaders/notExpanded tail). local function updateCollapseAllIcon(numServices) local numHeaders, notExpanded = 0, 0 for i = 1, numServices do local name, _, serviceType, isExpanded = GetTrainerServiceInfo(i) if name and serviceType == "header" then numHeaders = numHeaders + 1 if not isExpanded then notExpanded = notExpanded + 1 end end end local b = getglobal("BenillaTrainerCollapseAllButton") if numHeaders > 0 and notExpanded == numHeaders then b.collapsed = 1 b:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") else b.collapsed = nil b:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") end end
function BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() getglobal("BenillaTrainerGreetingText"):SetText(GetTrainerGreetingText()) BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaTrainerMoney", GetMoney())
local numServices = GetNumTrainerServices() if numServices == 0 then getglobal("BenillaTrainerCollapseAllButton"):Disable() else getglobal("BenillaTrainerCollapseAllButton"):Enable() end
-- The faux-scroll bar reconciles to the row count, then hands back the top-row offset. local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaTrainerListScrollFrame") BenillaFauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, numServices, BENILLA_TRAINER_ROWS, BENILLA_TRAINER_ROW_HEIGHT) local skillOffset = BenillaFauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillHighlight"):Hide()
-- Fill the visible rows (ref ClassTrainerFrame_Update's row loop). Header rows show the skill -- line name + a +/- fold; service rows blank the fold, indent the name two spaces, and colour -- name+subtext by state (available green / used gray / unavailable red). for i = 1, BENILLA_TRAINER_ROWS do local button = getglobal("BenillaTrainerService" .. i) local index = i + skillOffset if index <= numServices then local name, subText, serviceType, isExpanded = GetTrainerServiceInfo(index) if not name then name = UNKNOWN_LABEL end if serviceType == "header" then button.name:SetText(name) button.name:SetTextColor(NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b) button.subtext:SetText("") if isExpanded then button:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") else button:SetNormalTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") end button.foldHighlight:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Hilight") else button:SetNormalTexture("") button.foldHighlight:SetTexture("") button.name:SetText(" " .. name) if subText and subText ~= "" then button.subtext:SetText(format(PARENS_TEMPLATE, subText)) else button.subtext:SetText("") end if serviceType == "available" then button.name:SetTextColor(0, 1.0, 0) button.subR, button.subG, button.subB = 0, 0.6, 0 elseif serviceType == "used" then button.name:SetTextColor(GRAY_FONT_COLOR.r, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.g, GRAY_FONT_COLOR.b) button.subR, button.subG, button.subB = 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 else button.name:SetTextColor(0.9, 0, 0) button.subR, button.subG, button.subB = 0.6, 0, 0 end button.subtext:SetTextColor(button.subR, button.subG, button.subB) end button.serviceIndex = index button:Show() else button.serviceIndex = nil button.name:SetText("") button.subtext:SetText("") button:SetNormalTexture("") button.foldHighlight:SetTexture("") button:Hide() end end
-- Selection highlight + detail (ref l.146-186). The glow rides the selected SERVICE row while -- it is inside the visible window; a header selection shows no glow. The detail fills only for -- a selected service. local selection = GetTrainerSelectionIndex() local selType if selection >= 1 and selection <= numServices then _, _, selType = GetTrainerServiceInfo(selection) end if selType and selType ~= "header" and selection > skillOffset and selection <= skillOffset + BENILLA_TRAINER_ROWS then local selButton = getglobal("BenillaTrainerService" .. (selection - skillOffset)) local hl = getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillHighlight") local tex = getglobal("BenillaTrainerSkillHighlightTexture") if selType == "available" then tex:SetVertexColor(0, 1.0, 0) elseif selType == "used" then tex:SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) else tex:SetVertexColor(0.9, 0, 0) end hl:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", selButton, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) hl:Show() -- The selected row's text goes white (HIGHLIGHT) — a deliberate divergence from the ref, -- which whitens only the subtext + LockHighlight and leaves the name state-coloured: the -- director wants the whole selected row legible against its colour glow (a red/gray glow -- swallows red/gray text). Runs AFTER the per-row state colouring above, so it wins for -- the selected row; subR/subG/subB go white too so a hover-then-leave keeps it white. selButton.name:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) selButton.subtext:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) selButton.subR, selButton.subG, selButton.subB = HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b end
if selType and selType ~= "header" then BenillaTrainer_ShowDetails(selection) else BenillaTrainer_HideDetails() end
updateCollapseAllIcon(numServices) end
-- The window's wheel handler (bubbled up the parent chain from a row) → one row via the faux kit. function BenillaTrainerFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("BenillaTrainerListScrollFrame"), delta) end
-- A row click: a header folds/unfolds its group (Collapse/ExpandTrainerSkillLine take the header's -- display index); a service selects (ref ClassTrainerSkillButton_OnClick + SetSelection's header -- branch). Left-button only. function BenillaTrainerSkillButton_OnClick(button, mouseButton) if mouseButton ~= "LeftButton" then return end local index = button.serviceIndex if not index then return end local _, _, serviceType, isExpanded = GetTrainerServiceInfo(index) if serviceType == "header" then if isExpanded then CollapseTrainerSkillLine(index) else ExpandTrainerSkillLine(index) end else SelectTrainerService(index) end BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() end
-- Hover recolors a service row's subtext to HIGHLIGHT, restoring its state colour on leave (ref -- ClassTrainerSkillButton_OnEnter/OnLeave). Harmless over a header (its subtext is blank). function BenillaTrainerSkillButton_OnEnter(button) button.subtext:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) end
function BenillaTrainerSkillButton_OnLeave(button) button.subtext:SetTextColor(button.subR or 0.5, button.subG or 0.5, button.subB or 0.5) end
-- ── The Train button ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Buy the selected service, then repaint (the row flips to "used" once the app pushes the fresh -- snapshot). The tradeskill profession-confirm dialog is a later refinement. function BenillaTrainerTrainButton_OnClick() BuyTrainerService(GetTrainerSelectionIndex()) BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() end
-- ── The state-filter dropdown (ref ClassTrainerFrameFilterDropDown_*) ──────────────────────── function BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown_OnLoad() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown, BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown_Initialize) UIDropDownMenu_SetText(FILTER_LABEL, BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(96, BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown) end
function BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown_Initialize() local function addRow(kind, label, code) local info = {} info.text = code .. label .. CODE_CLOSE info.value = kind info.func = BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown_OnClick info.checked = GetTrainerServiceTypeFilter(kind) and 1 or nil info.keepShownOnClick = 1 UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end addRow("available", LABEL_AVAILABLE, GREEN_CODE) addRow("unavailable", LABEL_UNAVAILABLE, RED_CODE) addRow("used", LABEL_USED, GRAY_CODE) end
-- A row's func fires with the row button as `this`, carrying the PRE-click state (this.value / -- this.checked): the kit's UIDropDownMenuButton_OnClick runs the func FIRST and only then, for a -- keepShownOnClick row, flips the check texture + this.checked itself. So the func's whole job is -- to flip the ENGINE filter to the inverse of the pre-click check, reset scroll, and repaint — -- the visible check is the kit's to move, and the next open re-derives every row from -- GetTrainerServiceTypeFilter anyway. -- -- It must NOT re-Initialize the open menu here. Doing so re-ran AddButton, which sets -- `button.checked` (and the Check texture) from the fresh engine state — so the kit's flip -- immediately afterwards inverted the ALREADY-correct row and put it back. The check never -- appeared to move, and because `this.checked` then read stale-true forever, a filter switched -- off could never be switched back on. function BenillaTrainerFilterDropDown_OnClick() -- The engine filter AND the saved global, together: the global is what survives the -- restart and what BenillaTrainerFrame_ApplyFilter pushes back after the per-packet -- reset, so writing only the engine would lose the toggle at the next list (the ref's -- own setglobal pair, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:526-530). local on = 0 if not this.checked then on = 1 end setglobal("TRAINER_FILTER_" .. strupper(this.value), on) SetTrainerServiceTypeFilter(this.value, on) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaTrainerListScrollFrame"), 0) BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() end
-- ── The collapse-all tab ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Fold / unfold every group (Collapse/ExpandTrainerSkillLine(0), ref -- ClassTrainerCollapseAllButton_OnClick). function BenillaTrainerCollapseAllButton_OnClick() local b = getglobal("BenillaTrainerCollapseAllButton") if b.collapsed then b.collapsed = nil ExpandTrainerSkillLine(0) else b.collapsed = 1 BenillaFauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaTrainerListScrollFrame"), 0) CollapseTrainerSkillLine(0) end BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() end
-- ── The NPC-session lifecycle (MerchantFrame.xml's own shape) ──────────────────────────────── function BenillaTrainerFrame_OnLoad(frame) -- The NPC portrait: the "npc" unit token → the trainer's live model bake -- (crates/benilla/src/portrait, InteractNpc) — MerchantFrame's own binding. SetPortraitTexture(getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Portrait"), "npc") frame:RegisterEvent("TRAINER_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("TRAINER_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("TRAINER_CLOSED") frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") -- The faux-scroll frame repaints the list through this window's Update. getglobal("BenillaTrainerListScrollFrame").updateFunc = BenillaTrainerFrame_Update end
-- Push the three saved globals into the engine — the ref's ClassTrainerFrame <OnShow> -- (Blizzard_TrainerUI.xml:531-533), and it is NOT redundant: the list builder rewrites the -- engine's filter mask to its own default on every SMSG_TRAINER_LIST (byte-verified, -- `0x4d75d9 mov ds:0xb73a1c,3`; decision 1128), so this is what puts the player's remembered -- choice back. Called on show and at the top of TRAINER_SHOW — our repaint runs before -- ShowUIPanel, so applying it only in OnShow would leave one frame painted under the reset. function BenillaTrainerFrame_ApplyFilter() SetTrainerServiceTypeFilter("available", TRAINER_FILTER_AVAILABLE) SetTrainerServiceTypeFilter("unavailable", TRAINER_FILTER_UNAVAILABLE) SetTrainerServiceTypeFilter("used", TRAINER_FILTER_USED) end
function BenillaTrainerFrame_SetTitle(name) if name and name ~= "" then getglobal("BenillaTrainerTitleText"):SetText(name) else getglobal("BenillaTrainerTitleText"):SetText("Trainer") end end
function BenillaTrainerFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "TRAINER_SHOW" then -- Fresh session: top of the list, a first selection (ref ClassTrainerFrame_Show). BenillaTrainerFrame_ApplyFilter() BenillaTrainerFrame_SetTitle(arg1) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(getglobal("BenillaTrainerListScrollFrame"), 0) if GetTrainerSelectionIndex() == 0 then selectFirstService() end BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() ShowUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "TRAINER_UPDATE" then BenillaTrainerFrame_SetTitle(arg1) -- Re-anchor the selection if it fell off the (possibly shorter) list. if GetTrainerSelectionIndex() == 0 then selectFirstService() end BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() elseif event == "TRAINER_CLOSED" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "PLAYER_MONEY" then BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaTrainerMoney", GetMoney()) -- A buy changes affordability without a TRAINER_UPDATE — repaint the detail's cost tint. if BenillaTrainerFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaTrainerFrame_Update() end end end
function BenillaTrainerCloseButton_OnClick() CloseTrainer() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaTrainerFrame")) end

Scripts.OnLoad: self.name = getglobal(self:GetName() .. "Name") self.subtext = getglobal(self:GetName() .. "SubText") self.foldHighlight = self:GetHighlightTexture()
